profile.style: Emotional glow-up edits built around breakup pain, self-love, and looksmaxxing, usually with sad audio and minimal captioning.
works: Breakup-to-glow-up angle: 307,800 views and 3.9× usual on the Aug 13 post
Emotional self-love framing: 148,400 views and 1.9× usual on the Sep 2 post
Tom Odell slowed sound paired with transformation content worked on both top posts
Simple broad themes like breakup, discipline, self-love got the most saves: 2,284 and 339 saves
doesnt: Vague relationship question without a clear transformation: the Oct 15 post got 582 views
Generic healing caption without a sharp before/after: the Sep 4 post got 8,504 views, 0.1× usual
The actual voice app promise is not obvious in the best-performing captions

ideas.so: Your Aug 13 breakup/self-love edit got 307,800 views, 20,000 likes, and 2,284 saves — 3.9× your usual views. The move now is not to change the emotion; it is to make the voice glow-up part impossible to miss.
why: It keeps the exact emotional lane that gave you 307,800 views and 2,284 saves on Aug 13.
It fixes the weak spot in the account: the best posts work emotionally, but the voice app promise is not obvious enough.
It avoids the vague question problem from Oct 15, which only got 582 views, by giving a clear before/after.
ideas.sound: Another Love (slowed down original sound) · Tom Odell, low volume under voiceover
ideas.format: Emotional breakup-to-glow-up edit with minimal white captions and one clear app screen moment

script.say: She left. Now fix your voice.
script.shot: Black screen, then a low-light clip of a guy staring at old texts. Small white text: “day 1”.

script.say: Not for her. For the version of you that stopped speaking up.
script.shot: Mirror clip, hoodie, tired face. Quick close-up of him deleting the chat.

script.say: Train your tone. Slow down. Stop mumbling.
script.shot: Screen recording-style shot of humm.app voice feedback, then him recording one line.

script.say: The glow-up is not just your face. It is how you sound when you walk in.
script.shot: Cut to cleaner outfit, haircut, posture change, walking outside at night.

script.say: If you are in your breakup era, start with your voice.
script.shot: Before/after split: “mumbled / calm” and “chasing / chosen”. End on app logo or app screen for one second.

ideas.caption: Should we make this a 7-day voice glow-up series? Comment “VOICE”.
ideas.post_time: Sunday 8:30 PM, when your audience is free before the week starts
ideas.make_it_yours: Change only one thing from the winning format: keep the sad Tom Odell glow-up, but put the voice transformation in the first 3 seconds.

ideas.so: @vanessa.loft’s “A lot changes in 2 years” format got 15,000,000 views and 74,493 saves by making time feel emotional and visual. Adapt it to your niche with a male breakup arc: old voice, old posture, old self-respect — then the new version.
why: The borrowed format is proven in the niche: a simple time-change hook drove 15,000,000 views and 74,493 saves for a creator ahead of you.
Your own best posts are also transformation edits, especially the Aug 13 and Sep 2 posts.
It gives viewers a reason to follow beyond one edit: they expect more steps in the glow-up.
ideas.hook: "A lot changes when you stop begging."
ideas.sound: original sound / soft voiceover with low sad piano
ideas.format: Time-jump transformation edit: “6 months ago” to “now,” built around breakup recovery

script.say: A lot changes when you stop begging.
script.shot: Old-looking selfie/video, messy room, text overlay: “6 months ago”.
Close-up of thumb hovering over phone, then locking it.

script.say: You stop explaining yourself to people who already decided.
script.shot: Gym bag, skincare shelf, haircut appointment clip, quiet montage.

script.say: You start fixing the things you avoided. Even your voice.
script.shot: humm.app recording screen; waveform or score-style feedback without over-explaining.
Clean final fit, eye contact with camera, one-second smile, cut to black.

ideas.caption: What changed you more: the breakup or the silence after? Comment one word.
ideas.post_time: Tuesday 9:00 PM, when people are scrolling after work or school
ideas.make_it_yours: Do not copy the exact life story; make it a male breakup recovery edit where the surprise change is his voice confidence.

ideas.so: #fyp is rising in the niche this week: 3 videos this week versus 1 last week, across 4 creators. Use it on a post that still fits your account, because your broad breakup/discipline/self-love themes have already pulled your biggest numbers.
why: It rides #fyp while it is rising in this niche, without abandoning your breakup glow-up lane.
It brings back the clear breakup framing that worked on Aug 13 and Sep 2, instead of the vague Oct 15 question.
The action is simple and app-native: record, hear the issue, improve the line.
ideas.sound: Another Love · Tom Odell, quiet under voiceover
ideas.format: Fast emotional advice edit with a practical one-night action

script.say: If she left, do this tonight.
script.shot: Dark room, phone face down, sad blue lighting. Text: “don’t text her”.

script.say: Record your voice saying one confident sentence.
script.shot: Guy opens humm.app and records: “I’m not chasing what chose to leave.”

script.say: Listen back. Fix the mumbling. Say it slower.
script.shot: Replay moment, then second recording. Quick captions: “slower / deeper / clearer”.

script.say: Now go sleep. Tomorrow, become harder to ignore.
script.shot: Phone goes on charger, shoes by the door, alarm set for morning gym/walk.
Morning shot, hoodie on, walking outside. End text: “day 1 starts now”.

ideas.caption: Would you try this tonight or text her instead? Comment honestly.
ideas.post_time: Thursday 8:00 PM, when your audience is free and weekend feelings start hitting
ideas.make_it_yours: Keep it quiet and emotional, not tutorial-heavy; the app should feel like part of the breakup recovery ritual.

plan.summary: Post three glow-up edits: one direct sequel to your best breakup edit, one borrowed “time changed me” transformation, and one #fyp ride with a sharper first line. All three turn the same emotion into a follow reason: guys should follow because this account shows the breakup-to-confidence path, including voice.
plan.headline: People come for *breakup pain turned into a glow-up*: your Aug 13 post got 307,800 views and 2,284 saves. This week, keep the sad edit style, but make the app promise obvious: *his voice changes too*.

patterns.title: Breakup-to-glow-up is the strongest lane.
patterns.detail: The Aug 13 post hit 307,800 views, 20,000 likes, 858 shares, and 2,284 saves — 3.9× your usual views. The Sep 2 breakup/glow-up post also beat usual with 148,400 views.

patterns.title: Sad Tom Odell + transformation beats generic healing.
patterns.detail: Both top posts used Tom Odell slowed/Another Love with transformation framing. The Sep 4 generic healing caption without a sharp before/after got 8,504 views, far below those two.

patterns.title: Vague relationship questions do not give people enough to follow for.
patterns.detail: The Oct 15 post asked “Should he get her back?” and got 582 views, 8 likes, and 3 saves. The stronger posts give a clear identity shift: breakup, discipline, self-love, glow-up.
